mentions.name: LanguagePuppy
mentions.description: A SaaS project the author is working on; the need to take and share screenshots for it is what motivated building the Backdrop screenshot tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: The idea came from trying to find a neat screenshot app on Linux for taking and sharing screenshots for another SaaS I'm working on: LanguagePuppy [2], but I couldn't find one that worked.
